# Stand Firm in the Gap
## Scripture
"Watch, stand fast in the faith, be brave, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul’s closing words to the Corinthians aren't a suggestion; they are a battle cry. He lists four imperatives: Watch, Stand, Be Brave, Be Strong. Notice the order. You cannot be strong if you are not watching. You cannot be brave if you are not standing. The enemy doesn't fear your physique; he fears your vigilance. A warrior who sleeps on duty is a liability, not an asset. Today, the battlefield isn't a foreign land—it is your workplace, your living room, and your mind. The world will tell you to relax your standards, to blend in, to compromise "just a little." But you are called to hold the line. Your strength is not for show; it is for service. Your bravery is not for pride; it is for protection. Stand firm in the gap for your family and your faith, knowing that the One who commands you is the One who empowers you.

## Daily Challenge
Before you start your day, do 20 pushups. With each rep, say, "I am watching. I am standing. I am strong in the Lord."
